notes.title: Faeria Friday, August 19th, 2016: Hammering out content
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/2016/Aug19/banner.png

Monthly Cup qualifiers start tomorrow! Aquablad has a great video for beginners, and we talk more about the upcoming solo content.

Monthly Cup Qualifiers

It's already time to begin the next set of Monthly Cup qualifiers!

The first will be kicking off tomorrow, Saturday at 6pm CEST, but don't fret over timezones - just keep an eye on the countdown timer on our Monthly Cup landing page.

Eight players will advance to the Monthly Cup and compete for over $3000 in cash prizes.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/newsletters/Aug192016_testing/MonthlyCupLogo.png

This week, the qualifiers will be broadcast by **Cappuccino** and **HeliosAflame**, two of the top players in the game, on Cappuccinno's Twitch channel. It should be very interesting to watch, considering players will be coming fresh off of the balance patch from earlier this week. What decks do you think will come out on top?

One important adjustment we've made recently to tournament lobbies is the total allotted Timebank. When we first implemented the Timebank system, we wanted to initially place it in a spot that had a lot of breathing room. It has proven to be the case. After observing a number of tournaments, we are confident we can slightly tighten up the numbers and move on from here.

 Best of 3 - Now 30 minute persistent Timebank (Down from 36)
 Best of 5 - Now 50 minute persistent Timebank (Down from 60)

...Oh, you want to play? It's not too late to register:
   
Click here to sign up for Saturday's qualifier

Make land? wat do?

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/newsletters/Aug192016_testing/basic-land.png

Having trouble deciding where to place your lands? It's okay, you're not alone - it's one of the important pieces of basic strategy in Faeria that appears simple on the surface, but can have an incredibly subtle impact on the flow of the entire game.

Don't cave in from the pressure, though. Aquablad from PlayFaeria.com has put together an excellent video for those who would like to learn more about this delicate operation. Click the image above to give it a watch.

Solo content in testing

As we mentioned in our Free-to-play announcement for August 24th, a heap of new solo content will be making its way into the game very soon. We are currently in the final phases of testing it and working out the final kinks before it makes its way to the masses.

We've had our ears to the door listening to a lot of chatter regarding the upcoming content, and we'd like to continue to manage everyone's expectations in this regard. We are very excited about the new solo experience we'll be introducing, but it will not be a traditional "story mode" or campaign where you move your token along a world map, as we've heard a few players speculate. We're going about it a slightly different way for now. As mentioned previously, the new content will offer a variety of challenges to complete - geared initially toward beginners, but ramping up slowly into more challenging and varied scenarios as you progress. These scenarios will introduce you to new characters within the Faeria universe and play out as individual bite-sized, tasty pieces. It's a very unique experience, and we think you'll enjoy it.

We plan on expanding this content more and more as time goes on, and we have full intentions of working as much story and lore into the solo content as possible, as we know a lot of our players desire.

------------------------------------------------------- 

Get ready for next week. Who wants to push the big red "Free-to-play" button?

- Gary @Atmaz

The first will be kicking off tomorrow, Saturday at 6pm CEST, but don't fret over timezones - just keep an eye on the countdown timer on our Monthly Cup landing page.

Eight players will advance to the Monthly Cup and compete for over $3000 in cash prizes.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/newsletters/Aug192016_testing/MonthlyCupLogo.png

This week, the qualifiers will be broadcast by **Cappuccino** and **HeliosAflame**, two of the top players in the game, on Cappuccinno's Twitch channel. It should be very interesting to watch, considering players will be coming fresh off of the balance patch from earlier this week. What decks do you think will come out on top?

One important adjustment we've made recently to tournament lobbies is the total allotted Timebank. When we first implemented the Timebank system, we wanted to initially place it in a spot that had a lot of breathing room. It has proven to be the case. After observing a number of tournaments, we are confident we can slightly tighten up the numbers and move on from here.

 Best of 3 - Now 30 minute persistent Timebank (Down from 36)
 Best of 5 - Now 50 minute persistent Timebank (Down from 60)

...Oh, you want to play? It's not too late to register:
   
Click here to sign up for Saturday's qualifier

Make land? wat do?

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/newsletters/Aug192016_testing/basic-land.png

Having trouble deciding where to place your lands? It's okay, you're not alone - it's one of the important pieces of basic strategy in Faeria that appears simple on the surface, but can have an incredibly subtle impact on the flow of the entire game.

Don't cave in from the pressure, though. Aquablad from PlayFaeria.com has put together an excellent video for those who would like to learn more about this delicate operation. Click the image above to give it a watch.

Solo content in testing

As we mentioned in our Free-to-play announcement for August 24th, a heap of new solo content will be making its way into the game very soon. We are currently in the final phases of testing it and working out the final kinks before it makes its way to the masses.

We've had our ears to the door listening to a lot of chatter regarding the upcoming content, and we'd like to continue to manage everyone's expectations in this regard. We are very excited about the new solo experience we'll be introducing, but it will not be a traditional "story mode" or campaign where you move your token along a world map, as we've heard a few players speculate. We're going about it a slightly different way for now. As mentioned previously, the new content will offer a variety of challenges to complete - geared initially toward beginners, but ramping up slowly into more challenging and varied scenarios as you progress. These scenarios will introduce you to new characters within the Faeria universe and play out as individual bite-sized, tasty pieces. It's a very unique experience, and we think you'll enjoy it.

We plan on expanding this content more and more as time goes on, and we have full intentions of working as much story and lore into the solo content as possible, as we know a lot of our players desire.

------------------------------------------------------- 

Get ready for next week. Who wants to push the big red "Free-to-play" button?

- Gary @Atmaz

notes.title: Patch notes: August 16th, 2016
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/newsletters/patchnotes_aug1616_1092x496.jpg

It's here! With the assistance of abundant player feedback and an intense period of internal testing and discussion, we've arrived at a set of balance changes for you to sink your teeth into. As always, we hope to improve the state of the game and increase the variety of decks played with each balance patch. We will continue to monitor and observe as always.

Card Changes

NEUTRAL
  
 Daring Adventurer   
Reduced Faeria cost by 1  
Now costs 4f   
(Down from 5f)* 
 
YELLOW
  
Shaytan Vampire   
Design reworked. 
Now:   
6f DD  
5/6  
Whenever Shaytan Vampire damages a god, you gain that much life.   
(was 7f DD, 7/4 Gift- This creature drains 2 life from all adjacent creatures) 
 Deathwish Ghoul 
Now: Last words - Gain 2f  
(was Last words - Gain 3f) 
 Oradrim Sagittarius   
Added both an additional Desert requirement and one  health.  
3f DD  
1/3  
(was 3f D, 1/2) 
 Wind Gate  
Reduced Faeria and Desert requirement by 1.  
Now: 1f D   
(instead of 2f DD) 
 
BLUE
  
 Sunken Tower  
Reduced Faeria cost by 1  
0f LL  
(was 1f LL)
 Prophet of Tides  
3f LL  
3/1    
"Move a land you control twice."  
(was 1/1, "Move a land twice")
 Mystic Beast  
Design reworked. Now:   
3f LLL  
2/5  
Gift: Gets +2/+0 and Jump if played adjacent to an enemy well.  
(was 3fL, Gift: Gets +2/+2 and Charge 2 if your opponent has 10f or more)   
 Ancient Herald  
Health increased by 1.  
5/6  
(was 5/5)
 
GREEN
  
 Ruunin's Champion renamed to Ruunin's Messenger  
5f F (was 4fF)  
3/5  (was 2/6)  
Jump. Whenever this creature attacks a god, add a random green creature to your hand and decrease its cost by 2f.  
(was: Whenever this creature attacks a god, add a random green creature to your hand. It gets +2/+2) 
 Faeria Tree  
Now blows up at 5 life instead of 6.
 
MULTICOLOR
 
 Apex Predator  
Increased Faeria cost by one.
 Soul Eater  
Now has:  
Flying, Charge 3
 Three Wishes:  
2f  (was 0f)    DDFFLLMM   
Gain 3 life   (was 4 life)   and copy the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck. They cost 3f  (was 2f)    less. You cannot wish for more wishes.  
 
Rarity Changes

The following cards were swapped in rarity in regards to the affects this balance patch will have on Pandora. With Ruunin's Messenger now a much more powerful force in the common slot, we wanted to shift it to Epic to make it a little less easy to pick.
 
 Ruunin's Messenge is now Epic (was common)
 Ruunin's Avenger is now Rare (was Epic)
 Sagami Elder is now Common (was Rare)
 
Click here for an explanation on how rarity changes are compensated in memoria automatically for you

Full disenchant values:

As a result of these balance changes, cards that have been reduced in power will be available for their full disenchant cost for 1 week. Those cards are as follows:  
  
 Apex Predator
 Three Wishes
 Shaytan Vampire
 Deathwish Ghoul
 Oradrim Sagittarius
  
Patch design notes:

Click here to head to our Official Boards and read some designer insight from Dan and the team


We'd like to give a big thank you to our Vanguard testers for taking time in helping to test this set of changes.

- The Faeria Team

notes.title: Faeria Friday August 12, 2016: Knowledge is power
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug12/banner-wisdom.png

Monthly Cup results, First-move advantage statistics, and a sneak peek at some of the upcoming Solo content. It must be a Faeria Friday!

Monthly Cup Results

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug12/MonthlyCup2Winners.png

Last Saturday our second Monthly Cup concluded, and we've crowned a new champion! The Monthly Cup is our official $3300 tournament that comes around at the end of every ladder season.

If you missed the live stream and want to see some of the matches, make sure to head over to this forum thread to watch the highlights.

The next qualifying season for the Monthly Cup is already underway. Make sure to track it at https://esports.faeria.com/ and remember to Vote for your Favorite player!

Free-to-play announcement

If you're reading this and are a new player, welcome!

Our Free-to-play announcement and celebration has brought in quite a few new faces. If you're looking for some help or want to make some new friends, the best place for that is by engaging with us in our official Discord channel, which you can also find by clicking the button in the lower left of your friends list in-game. If you're more inclined to read some articles or find some strategy guides to digest, try heading to Playfaeria.com. Lastly, don't forget to visit our Official Boards which you can access using your existing Faeria account. There's no shortage of helpful resources to get you started.

Go ahead, do a little exploring.

First-move advantage

First-move advantage, or "first turn advantage", is the inherent edge the first player to act receives in most turn-based strategy or card games. Chess, for example, has a generally accepted advantage of about 54% given to the White player. We've taken a lot of steps to mitigate this factor as much as reasonably possible, the most recent of which was adding a bonus of 2 Faeria to the Explore card earlier this year. The effects of this change impressed even us, as we observed win ratios hover comfortably close to 50% across the board.

However, a lot of you have been asking for a more detailed breakdown of these numbers, and we are more than happy to provide. Something interesting you'll notice is that as the Elo of the player rises, the advantage slightly increases.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug12/FirstTurn-Thumbnail.png

Click the image above to open a more detailed infographic on exactly where we stand right now on first-move advantage.

Upgrading to the Early Access bundle

A common question we've been getting is how to upgrade your free account into one with the Early Access bundle that has the exclusive cosmetics and booster packs. While there's currently no easy way to do this without a coupon from outside of Steam, we are planning on making some upgrades to our in-game store that should arrive by version 0.8 on August 24th.

You'll be able to easily purchase this upgrade in-game with a click of a button, if that's something you're into. No pressure.

Solo Content Preview

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug12/Hoaka.png

As you see above, Hoaka will be part of the heavy amount of Solo content bundled into our August 24th update. He's pretty clever - or at least he thinks he is.

The new Solo experience will be centered around Epic quests and challenges like this one, which will introduce you to new characters and tell you a little more about some of the major players in the Faeria universe. After the update, there should be over 20 hours of solo content, including the introduction of 30 tricky puzzles for you to solve.

Make no mistake: All Solo content in the next update will be completely free and require no extra purchase.

Pretty cool, no?
Gary(@Atmaz)

notes.title: Faeria goes Free-to-play on August 24th!
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Announcements/banner-architect_1600x768.jpg

Free to Play is coming

As we mentioned in our last roadmap update, we have a few milestones to reach before we exit Early Access. The first milestone will be releasing the next major version, **v0.8**, and make the transition into a completely Free to Play model while we're at it.  

So yeah, the wait is soon over as the date is set for August 24th! 

New Content

With every big version release comes important features, and v0.8 will be no exception. Brand new single player content will be added to the game for the first time since Early Access launched. "Solo" mode will grow from being an important but small part of the game to becoming a full blown single player experience. It will not only help new players learn how to play Faeria, but offer a variety of challenging scenarios to complete. We aim to have around 20 hours of solid single player content to begin with, and plan to steadily increase that amount over the coming months and years. Other changes in this milestone update will include new supported languages, newly designed Mythic card layouts, and numerous other smaller improvements and optimizations.

Tablet Testing

During September we will begin private alpha testing for the iOS tablet version. Remember, you can still apply to be a part of this testing by filling out the form referred to on our main post. This will be the first stage in our development for mobile platforms. Further tablet support and testing will be announced later this year.

Download Faeria today, for Free!

In celebration of this announcement, Faeria is available to **download for free** right now on Steam, for a 24 hour period that began last night. Add the game to your account now and keep access to it forever! This promotion will end at 4:00pm Pacific (1:00am CEST). Click here to visit the Steam Store page.

- The Faeria Team

notes.title: Faeria Friday August 5th, 2016: Our cup runneth over
notes.content:
We're looking for iOS testers! Also - Don't forget, the next $3000 Monthly Cup takes place in less than 24 hours. Track it on our Esports website and tune in to FaeriaTV to catch it live.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug5/banner-windstormcharger_1600x768.jpg

iOS Testing

Want to try Faeria out on your iPad? We have a version that works, and we'll soon be ready to roll out testing with a selected few players!

If you're interested in testing, please apply by filling out this form. Your help in this matter is greatly appreciated.

Monthly Cup this weekend

The second ever Faeria Monthly Cup kicks off this Saturday at 4:00pm CEST. Don't worry about timezone conversions, just check the countdown timer at https://esports.faeria.com/live to know when you should tune in.

There's one more thing to take care of, however: We only have 31 players! Let's announce our final special guest and bring that number to 32:

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug5/Goswser.png

Representing ROOT Gaming, Goswser! For those not familiar with him as a former pro player and caster from the Starcraft 2 scene, he takes the meaning of a "Double U" literally - it's pronounced Gosu User. He's been playing a lot of Faeria lately and is interested in giving our Monthly Cup a shot. He'll need to bring his A-Game, however, as our brackets are going to be packed with fierce competition.

Don't forget, this time we'll be placing $150 bounties on the top two finishers from the previous cup.

Eggbot is cracked

It's worth mentioning that we will not be utilizing the Eggbot this weekend. We know some of you may have become accustomed to being bombarded in a shower of gold, eggs, and Orbs while watching each Monthly Cup, but we're working on improving it for the future so we can continue using it in interesting ways without becoming too repetitive. This weekend, let's focus on the games themselves.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug5/Yak_security2.png

We are prepared for the ensuing Egg riots that will attempt to bring down our Twitch chat, and will be deploying extra security as a contingency plan to keep the peace.

The Power of Pandora

It's been a week since the release of the new Pandora, and the feedback we've been hearing is overwhelmingly positive. We're very happy to see so many are enjoying the changes.

That said, we know there are still improvements to be made in a lot of different areas, so you still shouldn't consider this its final form.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Aug5/pandora-thumbnail.pngClick the image above to jump to the video

If you haven't been following development along recently, the above video from GamersOrigin's Typhus should pretty much sum things up. It's in French, but what happens is probably understandable through any language barrier.

Mentor program

Getting into Faeria but having a hard time mastering the meta? Feel free to enroll in the new mentoring program for free, here on our forums!

Volunteer coaches will work with you in short sessions to give you tips on how to improve your game. Not only is it free to enroll, but you'll get a booster pack at the end of each completed session!

We're looking for both students and more coaches. Check the thread for more information.

Next balance patch

We know a lot of you have been asking for when the next balance patch will be. The design team has been discussing things for quite some time now, but don't want to interrupt this weekend's tournament. Expect some changes put together some time after this weekend's Monthly Cup. We'll keep you updated as much as we can on this.

Screenshots sharing

If you haven't caught it yet on our forums, we're looking for some of your best screenshots.

Submit them here, and we may end up using them on our social media - with your name on them.

See you this weekend!
- Gary (@Atmaz)

notes.title: Patch notes: August 2nd, 2016
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/patch-notes-august-2nd-2016.png


Bug Fixes


Fixed the "Invite a friend" daily quest that was looping when 5 wins were reached.
Punishment now deals 5 damage to treasure cards, as if they were neutral.
Fix the issue with some accounts that were stuck in games.
Given the second card back to God players.
Fix tournament lobby bug where it was sometimes possible to start with no matches format selected, resulting in first game ending right after mulligan.
Usernames with accentuated characters (ö, é, è, ç,...) were broken ; they are going to be fixed gradually today (most of them automatically, some manually just after the update). Accentuated characters will be replaced by their ASCII counterparts (é è -> e,...).
Higher league opponent star that was not given anymore is back! (If opponent is 5 ranks or more better, an additional star is awarded).
Versus Screen Bug has been resolved..


The Versus bug has been an issue for a number of players, it was caused by rare ping spikes when challenging an AI opponent, but should now be resolved.

notes.title: Pandora Awakens
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/29072016_Pandora_Update.jpg

The History of Pandora

Nearly three months ago we released our new game mode, Pandora, with the goal of creating a brand new experience that is both exciting and different from our normal constructed mode. During this time we have been listening closely to feedback from you, our community, about what you all love or hate about Pandora (as we do for all aspects of Faeria!)

Before releasing Pandora, we expected to hear strong opinions on it - we tried to make this a really crazy form of Faeria, and knew it couldn’t be to absolutely everyone’s taste. Sure enough, immediately we started hearing strong negative views from some of our players, but at the same time it instantly became our most-played game mode - which it still is to this day - and we also heard lots of positive feedback as well. Because of this, we wanted to take the time to see how opinions would change over time, while also exploring many different ideas for how to improve it.

With all the feedback we gathered, we have created many different versions of Pandora to test internally, and ran many sessions on our private servers for Vanguard testers to try out, and we believe that today’s update will make Pandora an exciting game mode for even more of you. We have tuned down the craziness, while keeping some additional layers of excitement above and beyond constructed mode. We now think that the core concept of Pandora is set in stone, but we will keep listening to your feedback and keep tweaking it wherever necessary.

We mentioned the Vanguard testers above, and would like to take this opportunity to thank all participants in our Vanguard program, and especially those who have helped us test Pandora in the lead-up to this update. We are grateful to our entire playerbase for helping us during our Early Access stage of development, but Vanguard testers regularly go above and beyond in helping us find the right balances in the game, so please take a moment to recognise their dedication. You can also apply to join the Vanguard program - find out more in our Faeria Friday from July 15th.

Enough backstory, let’s find out what’s new in Pandora!

The New Pandora: An Overview

Drafting

Drafting a deck now means picking 30 normal cards, like before, but also 3 Treasures. 
Treasures are powerful creatures, structures or events, and are available only in Pandora, not in booster packs or constructed mode.
Shards are shuffled randomly into players’ decks, just as before. 
Shards do not do anything individually, but once 5 Shards have been drawn Pandora will awaken.


Once Pandora awakens:

Both players receive one of the three Treasures that they drafted.
Players now receive 6 faeria per turn rather than 3 (as in the old version).
Faeria wells are depleted for the rest of the game (as in the old version).
Remaining shards are removed from decks, and two ‘Treasure Found!’ cards are randomly placed into each player's deck. 
When drawn, these cards give each player one of their remaining Treasures.
Once all three Treasures have been found, the remaining 'Treasure Found' cards are removed from the decks.


For a full list of Treasures you can check out PlayFaeria.com or Faeria.GamersOrigin.com, but here are three to give you a taste:

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/3Treasures.png

Why Have We Made These Changes To Pandora? 

We want Pandora to offer maximum excitement, increased uncertainty and the chance to see come backs late in the game, and we are confident that Treasures deliver exactly this, without adding random elements through-out the game that would feel out of place.

Artifacts in the old Pandora mode could slip into your game without warning, potentially overshadowing players’ strategies and drafts. Unlike the old Artifacts, Treasures are drafted by players, who can then decide if and when to spend faeria playing them. We’ve made sure that Treasures can be worked into certain strategies, and will have an important and intriguing place in your decks, in a way that we never envisioned with Artifacts in the previous versions of Pandora.

Sudden Death!

Think of Pandora awakening as a ‘sudden death mode’, more than anything else. Because Treasures are only drawn after Pandora awakens, they can only influence the last turns of a game. This way, the early-mid game really feels like constructed Faeria, and it’s possible to finish the game even before Pandora awakens, if you are fast enough. But when Pandora does awaken, the increased faeria per round, well depletion and the mighty Treasures can change the outcome to produce to an exciting and memorable climax.

What’s Next For Pandora?

As mentioned above, we will keep listening to your feedback. But changes to Pandora aren’t limited to drafting and gameplay, we are also looking to introduce a new ranking system in the future, as requested by the community.

We are currently studying several different possibilities, but right now we don’t want to remove the current ranking system until we have a new system designed and ready to replace it. If you have any thoughts or suggestions on this topic, all ideas are very welcome! Let us know your thoughts in this boards post.

Due to the nature of this update, current Pandora runs will no longer be valid - however, we are giving every user one free Pandora coin to start your first run in the updated mode.

We hope you love the new Pandora as much as we do - go check it out now!


The Faeria Team

p.s. This patch included some other, non-Pandora updates, which you can read about here

notes.title: Faeria Friday July 22nd, 2016: The Road Ahead
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Jul22/banner.gif

The Road Ahead

Our Early Access development roadmap has been a constantly evolving, flexible plan of action. With the help of the feedback we get from the community, we have the luxury of being able to judge which changes or features are needed most, and which can probably be pushed back to make way for the most critical updates. We evaluate the state of the game on a daily basis, and discuss the general sentiments of our players routinely. While this is great for the flow of valuable content into the game, it's not so great for being able to communicate to you, the player, what to expect by a certain date or exactly when a certain feature is going to be implemented. What we can do, however, is update you on our current plan and what you can expect from the future of Faeria in the broadest strokes possible. So, let's do that!

Free to Play timeline

As previously announced on our Steam store page, our goal is to open the game to all players for free by September – and this will definitely still happen. However, Free to Play does not necessarily mean the end of Early Access. One of the main barriers to opening these floodgates is our overall server stability and infrastructure. When Free to Play arrives, it means we are confident enough in our server infrastructure, client stability, and team size to scale up our testing and gain even more feedback as we work toward version 1.0, also known as full release and the end of Early Access.

What version number is Faeria right now?

If you look at the bottom left of your screen every time you start the game, you'll notice something close to the following number: "0.7.6044.18878". That's a lot of digits - but the first two are the most important for the purposes of this discussion: "0.7". Without going into the technical details of how our versioning system works, you can consider the current big picture version of Faeria to be v0.7 at this very moment.

In order to get to v1.0, we have two important numbers to reach first:

v0.8 (launched with Free to Play)
v0.9

Each of these versions will come with an important milestone, feature, or improvement that warrants such a change of the most significant digit.

In the next few weeks we will reveal the exact date Faeria will be going Free to Play. The release of Free to Play will coincide with what we will be declaring to be version v0.8.

Version 1.0 (and the end of Early Access) is expected to be ready within the next 6 months, which places v0.9 somewhere in between.

While we aren't spoiling the specific details of what to expect for each of these version numbers, we can tell you that there will be at least 10 new cards added between now and v1.0. As with Three Wishes, all cards added during the Early Access period will count as part of the "core set" and will therefore be given free to anyone who purchases or has purchased the current Core Set.

After the end of Early Access, the price of the core set (with all of the newly added cards) will change to $75, however if you want to purchase it at the current price of $50 you can certainly still do this until v1.0.

The first expansion cards

Any new cards released after v1.0 will come as part of expansions. Cards released in expansions will not be a part of the core set, and will not be available to purchase directly in the way that the core set currently is.

We know everyone is hungry for more details regarding expansions, and we of course will share more information about these when the time comes closer. For now, please understand that driving expansion content will be one of our primary focuses after release. We recognize the importance of putting shiny new toys into the toy box as often as possible. The first full-blown expansion can be expected within a few months of the release of v1.0.

Pandora

Pandora has, and still is, being vigorously tested and we'll give you news on the upcoming update very soon!  

Steam store page update

We have recently updated our Steam store page to reflect the above information more clearly. In the process of doing this, we have shifted around some of the previously listed features we hoped would make it into v1.0, but now are slated as post-release content or features.

In addition to this, a couple things have been removed altogether in order for the Steam store page to match up more completely with our current development plans. Fully integrated tournaments, console, and mobile versions have been pushed to post v1.0 development, while betting in-game currency on matches and server-unique cards have been removed from the list of stops on our roadmap. It's not to say that these two features will never make it into the game, but after understanding more about what our players really need it's become clear to us that these components are not critical features needed in Faeria.

There are some great additions on our internal roadmap that aren't yet announced, but if you have specific feature requests that you haven't already told us about, why not write something in this thread on our Boards

We hope you now have a more complete picture of what to expect for the rest of our Early Access period and beyond. If you've read this far, you clearly have a vested interest in Faeria's future, and we thank you for that. We think it's very important to keep you as up to date as possible in our ever-evolving development schedule. As always: Keep doing what you're doing, and let us know what you think.

The Faeria Team

notes.title: Patch notes: July 19th, 2016
notes.content:
##Client

- When the opponent mulligans some cards, they will no longer move from your hand to his.

##Server

- When you are disconnected during a game, the client will now prompt you that there is an issue.
- When your opponent gets disconnected, you will be notified that he has and a timer of 60 seconds will be displayed (the time he has to reconnect).

The above two changes are particularly important as you are now clearly shown when either you, or your opponent, has disconnected and that person needs to restart their client within 60 seconds to rejoin the current match.

To restart the client, simply open the control panel on the right hand side and click on 'Sign Out' (Not 'Exit'). You will be taken back to the 'Enter Game' screen and can then attempt to rejoin the server and your match.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/sidebar.png


If the reason why you have been disconnected still exists then notify us either in the #support channel in Discord, or send an email to support@faeria.com, and we'll try to ascertain what may be causing the issue. Please ensure that you do checks at your side to verify if other applications are experiencing the same issue.

Thanks

The Faeria Team

notes.title: Faeria Friday July 15th, 2016: Hall of Flame
notes.content:
Monthly Cup qualifiers are already on us, and we're looking for your help in testing Pandora!

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Jul15/banner.png


Hall of Fame

Our Esports landing page has been upgraded, and we now display the Hall of Fame from previous cups!

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Jul15/HallofFame.png

Earn your spot by competing in the first qualifier this month and your shot at over $3000 in prizes, taking place tomorrow.

Sign up for the Monthly Cup qualifier here

Playfaeria Open

The first cup in the Playfaeria open was taken by Nightingale last Sunday.

Remember, the Playfaeria Open is your option for a more casual tournament environment where you'd just like to sit down, have fun, and play some Faeria. That's what it's all about in the end, right?

Register here for the Playfaeria Open

Pandora update

Pandora is an extremely key aspect of the Faeria experience. We can't emphasize that enough. From the beginning we wanted to make it a very fun, somewhat casual adventure that is a pleasure to play.

We observe many players enjoying the mode already, but on the other hand acknowledge that there is still room for improvement in various areas. We have been testing a lot of different potential changes over the past couple of months, and we are now entering the final internal testing phase for our next iteration of the feature.

The new Pandora is already live on our Vanguard testing servers and feedback from it has been largely positive. We are confident that we will be ready to roll out these changes in the next coming weeks, rather than months.

Become a Vanguard

That said, we can still use your help. We are looking to hand-select a group of dedicated testers to help us hammer out the final details of the Pandora changes. If you are reading this, you already are a good candidate to join our program.

If you're interested, please follow the instructions and apply for our Stress Testing program here. Note that we use the term "Stress Testers" and "Vanguards" interchangeably.

Along with your application, please include:
Your Faeria usernameYour timezone and general availability 
Please note these are volunteer positions, and we may only be accepting a small amount of temporary participants at this time. If you have a group of friends you'd like to test with, make sure you mention that as well and include their Faeria usernames.

Thank you, and have a great weekend.
The Faeria Team

notes.title: The next Monthly Cup season is ready to begin!
notes.content:
With the first Monthly Cup complete, we're already moving on to the next! These things do happen monthly, after all. We've also got a few exciting changes to discuss.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Announcements/bannerJuly1316.png

Monthly Cup Results

Congratulations to the following players as champions of the first ever Monthly Cup:

 1st: Sweety 
Winnings: $1,500  
 2nd: HeliosAflame
Winnings: $1,000  
 3rd: Matthew
Winnings: $500  
The tournament was a great success, and a lot of fun. You can watch a recording of the entire tournament on Twitch, right here.

Friends list issues

We have been receiving a lot of reports where some players are unable to add each other to their friends list since the last client patch. We've recognized that a problem does exist, and will be patching it this week. In the meantime, sorry for the inconvenience!

Esports landing page

Esports.faeria.com is back to your regularly scheduled format, and you may now Vote for Your Favorite and track the Highest Gods.

Make sure to sign up for this weekend's Qualifier if you're interested!

Next Monthly Cup and Invited Guests

Based on feedback we've been getting from players (and in the interest of spicing things up a bit), we'll be making some changes to the next Monthly Cup.
Qualifier Format: As mentioned on our forum earlier this week, both qualifiers will be moving to Double Elimination.Invited Guests: We will be inviting the top two finishers of every Monthly Cup to the next cup. That means that both Sweety and HeliosAflame will have guaranteed spots next month, and will count as two of the four special invitees.https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Announcements/Sweety-card.pnghttps://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Announcements/HeliosAflame.png
(Both players have recently formed their own team together. Introducing: Apex!)
Krog's Bounty: Krog will be placing $150 bounties on the heads of these two players, every month! This sounds a lot more dangerous than it really is. Should anyone be able to defeat them in the next Monthly Cup, they will be able to claim the bounty. Should either win the next Monthly Cup, they will claim their own bounty. Special thanks to Sweety himself for coming up with this idea. Krog thinks it's great!Bracket Seeding:
(If you aren't interested in the technicalities of tournament structure, read no further!)
One of the most common lines of feedback from the first Monthly Cup were requests for some sort of adjustment to the randomized seeding. We do want to keep the matches occurring toward the end of the bracket as exciting as possible, and agree that some changes could be made to both help in this regard and increase the incentive for our best players to rank themselves as high as possible on the ladder during the season.
Therefore: We will be seeding 12 players. The top 4 seeds will go to our 4 special invitees in order of invitation: Meaning the winners of the previous cup will always have the best seeding, and the remaining invitees will be randomly selected for the 3rd and 4th seed.
The next 8 seeds will go to the highest ranked Gods of all remaining players, regardless of how they qualified. 
Seeding arrangement:1: Invited Guest #1 (Winner of previous cup, $150 Krog's Bounty)2: Invited Guest #2 (2nd place of previous cup, $150 Krog's Bounty)3-4 Invited Guest #3 and #4 (randomized)5-12: Highest 8 God ranks of all remaining qualified players, in order of #1- #8.13-32: Randomized. 

Prize distribution: 
We've also had some feedback regarding prize distribution, and will be looking to making changes to this in the future. Rather than decrease the current amount of winnings to the top finishers, we'd instead like to increase the total prize pool and distribute that amount to the next highest finishers. While these changes likely won't make it in the for next cup, it's something currently on the discussion table.

Thanks for reading!
Gary (@Atmaz)

notes.title: Patch notes: July 11th, 2016
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/patch-notes-july-11th-2016.png


New User Journey

New Player sign-up has been much improved and streamlined, with the following process applied:

Upon clicking Enter Faeria, the prologue mission immediately begins and they are asked to define a username.
If the first mission is completed quickly, the player will be asked if they want to skip the tutorial and will be taken to the Deckbuilder Tutorial (as if they have completed the entire prologue).
Once the Deckbuilder Tutorial has been completed, they will be asked to validate their account by entering in their email address and clicking on the link within the email they receive.
This should ease the new players into the game and allow them to quickly see how awesome Faeria is, before getting to the 'fiddly' part of registering their details. It's also the foundation that allows us to add in further account administration measures.


To further entice players, they will receive 2 free booster packs if they register with us!

UI and Animation Changes

Crafting Alert - You will now receive a warning when you attempt to craft unnecessary cards.
3 State Cursor - The cursor now changes when clicking and, soon, when hovered on an active game entity (a token, card, land ability, etc).
Spawn Effect - When a creature is summoned an impact effect is applied, the magnitude of which depends on the "size" of the creature.
Texture Compression - It's too technical for me, but some of the larger textures have now been compressed to improve memory management.

Card Art

Shamanic Dance
(Concept & Illustration by Sarah)
Grove Guardian
(Concept & Illustration by Sarah)
Ancient Herald
(Concept by Jordi/Franck - Illustration by Vitaliy)

Server Management

We are now better able to monitor the lag spikes players could be experiencing during games.

Have Fun

The Faeria Team

notes.title: Patch notes: July 8th, 2016
notes.content:
A small update will be made to Three Wishes today, as announced on our Discord channel earlier this week. Next week will be a much larger client patch.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/patchnotes_jul816.png
Card changesThree Wishes
Three Wishes now has the following text appended to the end:
"You cannot wish for more wishes."
This means that if you should use Three Wishes and your opponent has a Three Wishes in the top three cards of their deck - it will be ignored, and the next card will be drawn (You will still get 3 cards back).
In this way, we are targetting the way this card performs only in the mirror match, and it will not affect its balance in any other matchup.Monthly Cup deck preparations should not be affected by this change, and we are confident it is a positive adjustment that is needed sooner rather than later. Thank you!Pandora artifacts
The following artifacts of Pandora will no longer appear in game:
Garudan's ScaleTears of Ouroboros 
These Pandora changes actually were made earlier this week without a need for a client patch, but we chose to document them here. Thank you for your feedback on Pandora artifacts in general, and you can expect more significant adjustments to come. We have much more fundamental changes coming in the future, but for now we'd like to remove these shards from the Pandora experience.

Note: We have a much larger client patch incoming for next week which, among other things, will improve the flow of the initial login process for a new player, and open the door for more user account control in the future. The changes are significant enough to warrant more testing, so we will not be pushing them forward before the weekend.
The Faeria Team

notes.title: The First Monthly Cup
notes.content:
It's here! The first Monthly Cup begins this weekend.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Faeria_MC_News.png

The next ladder season has begun, and thirty-one of the players in first $3000 Monthly Cup are now set in stone, with the final invitee to be announced on Friday.

Check out the list on https://esports.faeria.com/ !

When:

July 9th, 4:00pm CEST

Where:
English stream: https://www.twitch.tv/faeriatv - hosted by Scream and Aquablad, featuring several community members!French stream: https://www.twitch.tv/gofaeria
The Return of the Egg

The Egg is returning.

You thought it was gone, but no. The Egg is ever-watching, ever-hatching.

Its companion, the Dragon Orb, must also return to protect it.

Watch either of the streams above to raise your egg timer. Every 30 minutes, rewards will be randomly sent out to anyone who qualifies.

We've reduced the Egg Timer requirement this time, meaning your rewards will scale even quicker - bringing you closer to the Egg with each heartbeat.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Egg.png
1 minute to 29 minutes: You have a chance to win 100 Gold30 minutes to 1 hour: You have a chance to win 250 Gold.
You will also have a chance to win the previous rewards.1 hours to 2 hours: You have a chance to win 1000 Gold.
You will also have a chance to win the previous rewards.2 hours to 3 hours: You are now eligible to win the precious Egg Avatar.
You will also have a chance to win the previous rewards.3 hours or more: At this point, you are worthy to receive sacred protection for your Egg. Watch more than 3 hours, and you have a chance to win the Dragon Orb, pictured below.
You will also have a chance to win the previous rewards.
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/DragonOrb.png

How do I become worthy of the Egg and its secrets?

Firstly, you will need to link Twitch to your Steam Account. Follow the previous link for further instructions. It’s very easy and takes only a moment. Once your accounts are linked, you are now ready to watch and increase your Egg Timer.

Every single minute you are watching one of the approved, oviparous streams, your Egg Timer will increase. The higher your Egg Timer, the more chances to win more valuable prizes. Every 30 minutes, prizes are distributed to active viewers based on the value of Egg Timers. Prizes will be sent to the email address linked to your Faeria account. If you already have an Egg, you may do with the code what you wish.

Pandora reset

Due to a bug, Pandora ranks have been reset as if it were a new season. This was not intentional, and Pandora is still considered to be in "Pre-Season" as we continue to rework its ranking system and develop something more suitable.

Since the Pandora ranks have been reset, we will be providing a one-time reward for Pandora ranks as follows:
Rank 20 or better => 1 Pandora Ticket Rank 15 or better => 3 Pandora Tickets Rank 10 or better => 3 Pandora Tickets and 500 gold 
These rewards have automatically been distributed.

In ADDITION to this, due to overwhelming player feedback, we will retroactively be awarding the basic Ranked seasonal card back to all God ranks, meaning God ranks of any season will receive both backs from now on instead of just the upgraded version.

Next qualifiers:
The dates of the qualifiers for the next Monthly Cup are July 16th and July 30th.
The Faeria Team

Having taken fourth place in the GO Faeria Clash this past April, TheFishou is returning for another chance at glory. A Frenchman from team GamersOrigin, TheFishou is a former poker and Magic: The Gathering player who has recently been known for his accomplishments in Hearthstone. We look forward to him impressing us once again.

Last week's invitee and global community manager for Alienware, AWLenard, has been continuing his "Road to the Cup" streams on the Alienware Twitch channel. Make sure to keep an eye out for him next week, and stop by to say hello!

Season Two Ending

July is here, and the next Ranked season will be upon us soon.

At the end of each Ranked season, player Ranks are reset as follows:

Current player rank → Rank after each reset

Ranks 20 to 25 → Rank 25 
Ranks 15 to 19 → Rank 20 
Ranks 10 to 14 → Rank 15 
Ranks God to 9 → Rank 10
 
Rewards are given as follows:

Rank 20 or better receives:
1 Pandora Coin
Rank 15 or better receives:
3 Pandora CoinsUnique seasonal card back
God ranks receive:
5 Pandora CoinsUpgraded version of seasonal card backTop 8 are automatically invited to the $3000 Monthly Cup

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Jul1/cardbg_back_s002-small.png https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/Jul1/cardbg_back_s002_gold-small.png

This season, you may notice some fancy glowing animations on these card backs.

Remember, the Ranked season ends on the first Monday of every month at 12:00pm Noon CEST. That places this season's end on July 4th, which is also the last day of the Steam Summer Sale that is currently in full swing!

We'll be closing the Vote For Your Favorite in the Monthly Cup at 11:59 CEST the night before on July 3rd - so get your votes in while you can for your favorite player to compete.

Note: Pandora currently does not have seasons, and the current temporary ranking system is still under evaluation and development.

First Monthly Cup: July 9th

We already have our 16 players from the open qualifiers this month and 3 special invitees. We'll know the next 12 after this coming Monday.

The following days will proceed as follows:
11:59pm (Just before Midnight) CEST July 3rd: Top 4 Votes are locked in12:00pm (Noon) CEST July 4th: Top 8 Gods are determinedJuly 8th: Final Invitee announcedJuly 9th: Monthly Cup takes place
A common question we're asked is, "How does it work if someone is already qualified and is Voted into the Top 4, or makes it into the Top 8 Gods?"

Excellent question. The precedence goes in the ordering that players have qualified. Open qualifiers are determined first, then Votes, then God Ranks. Anyone having already qualified will cede their spot to the next player in the next list.

For example, popular Korean player Gravekper has recently qualified in the tournament last weekend, but is currently number 4 in the Vote list. Should he remain in the Top 4, he will be passing his spot to the next in line on that list. Simple as that.

Of those 16 qualified players, anyone who is also in the Top 8 God ranks will then pass their spot to the next in the list. In the end, we will end up with 32 unique players for our Monthly Cup.

Then we get ready for the next one! For those interested. the Open Qualifiers for next season's Monthly Cup will take place July 16th and July 30th.

Coil Gaming's Lunar Rumble

While there's no Monthly Cup tournament this weekend, there's still an outlet to satisfy your desire for competition.

Coil Gaming will be hosting the 6th Lunar Rumble this Saturday.
Head to that Battlefy link to sign up for free and compete for in-game gold, Pandora coins, and most importantly - fun!

It would be a great way to feel out the initial results of the latest balance patch.

Have a great weekend.
- Gary (@Atmaz)

notes.title: Patch Notes : June 30th, 2016
notes.content:
https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/patchnotes-june292016_1092x496.jpg

A new patch introducing a brand new card! The mulligan system has been updated, and we've applied a set of balance changes and adjustments. The usual bug fixes and UI improvements are scattered throughout as well. Oh yeah, new card art too!


New Mulligan System

Based on heavy amounts of player feedback, we made a change to our current Mulligan system. At the beginning of each game, you may now select individual cards in your starting hand to be discarded and redrawn, instead of "all or nothing". We feel this should give players more control over their position in the start of the game and prevent some negative feelings that can result from being stuck with a poor hand.

New Card Added!

http://i.imgur.com/pab9P6Z.png

For the first time, harness the power of all four elements! Three Wishes allows you to sense your opponent's upcoming moves, then tap into those same powers for your own use.

As mentioned previously, this card is considered part of the core collection, and will be automatically awarded to anyone who has already purchased the Full Collection.

New Features

You may now choose to re-roll one Daily Quest per day

Game Reward Changes:

Players now receive XP when winning against the AI at or below level 15
Players now receive XP in the first 3 friendly matches of the day
Players may now receive an extra star when winning against a player of a higher league
Players now receive an extra star for first win of the day
Messages are now displayed explaining the reason behind each gained star
Players now receive 20 gold (instead of 10) for the first win of the day
Players no longer lose Elo rating when at the bottom of a league (except for rank 25). This ensures that players can't manipulate their rating to unfairly game the system.


Balance Changes and Card Reworks

Cartographer
Now has Last Words: Add an Explore to your hand.
(Was Last Words: Create a lake, a forest, a mountain, and a desert at random)
Note: Cartographer just cannot exist in a world where we'd like to continue to introduce 4 color cards and allow them to have powerful effects. Unfortunately, she had to be reworked to open up some breathing room for more design space. We hope with the recent power increase in elementals, going for four colors should be a more special experience.
Siege Engine
Now 2/6. (Was 3/6).
Gemsilk Faerie
Now gives +2/+2 and Charge 2 after drawing an event. (Was +2/0, Protection, and Charge 2)
Stormspawn
No longer draws a card upon death.
Mirror Phantasm
Is now 5/5, and transforms another creature into 5/5. (Was 4/4, 4/4)
Wavecrafter
Now requires 3 Lakes. (Was 2 Lakes.)
Tale of the Old Turtle
Now 6f LL. Draw 3 cards. All creatures drawn this way costs 2f less.
(Was 6f LLL, Add 3 random blue cards to your hand. They cost 3 less.)
Ruunin’s champion
Now 4f 2/6, effect reduced to +2/+2. (Was 6f 3/6, effect +3/+3)
Dune Drake
Is now 4f D. (Was 4f DD)
Shamanic Dance 
Is now 2f, and effect reduced to +0/+4 and Taunt (Was 3f, +0/+5 and Taunt)
Fire Elemental 
Is now a 5/2 and Gift - Create a Mountain (Was a 1/4, with Gift - Create a Mountain, Combat - Deal 2 damage to a random enemy creature)
Frogify (Common) and Humbling Vision (Rare) have swapped rarities. 
(Check here for an explanation on how rarity changes are refunded automatically to you)


Transformation Interactions:

A consistency issue has been corrected involving Protection and Haste: Transforming into a creature with Protection now gives Protection and transforming into a creature with Haste now gives Haste. The reverse of this is also true: transforming a creature with Haste or Protection into one without loses its Haste or Protection. Yes, this means after transforming a Ninja Toad, the new creature will no longer be able to attack (Unless it is transformed into a creature with Haste).

We realize this is a big interaction change for those used to the current game mechanics, but it's a behavior we've wanted to make more consistent for some time now, and we hope it now makes more logical sense.

We consider tokens on the board to be "entities." Entities may be a creature or structure and have any number of "characteristics," like Protection, Ranged, or Flying. When transforming an entity, creatures take on the characteristic(s) of the creature they transform into. For instance, when a Ranged creature transforms into a creature without Ranged, it can no longer attack from range. Whether or not that entity can attack or activate at all depends on the normal rules of summoning sickness- unless the new creature happens to have the characteristic of Haste. Therefore, when a Haste creature is now transformed into a non-Haste creature, it no longer can attack if it was summoned the same turn. The same now holds true for Protection, and creatures will gain or lose it after transformation depending on their characteristics. This should now make all transformation effects and Keyword behavior consistent in logic across the board.

(A more in-depth explanation of the balance changes can be found here)

UI adjustments and improvements, and features

The "compass" animation used for delivering the Explore card has been removed. We will be further reworking the flow of the start of the game in the future.
All Card Layouts have been updated
Many other small UI improvements
Background ambient SFX have been added to the game
Player levels are now hidden in Unranked mode.

Bug fixes

Hate Seed's cost should no longer decrease when it shouldn't decrease, regardless of how much it wants to.
Fixed an issue where tokens on board were not highlighting properly
Fixed an issue where tournament lobbies sometimes couldn't launch correctly.
Fixed lobby invite issue when two players invite each other at the same time
Fixed an issue in Pandora where a life of 0 was sometimes displayed on events that were transformed from creatures by a shard.

New Card art

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/new-art-june292016_2-thumb.png


Rebel Slinger
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Vitaliy)
King’s Faithful
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Vitaliy)
Blood Singer
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Tokkun Studio)
Blood Obelisk
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Tokkun Studio/Andrey)
Barbarian Ogre
(Concept> Christophe - Illustration > Tokkun Studio)
Battle Rager
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Tokkun Studio/Andrey)
Khalim’s Follower
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Vitaliy)
Demon Wrangler
(Yuan)
Bomb Slinger
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Tokkun Studio)
Axe Grinder
(Concept> Jordi/Franck - Illustration > Tokkun Studio/Andrey)

Note: The order listed above does not necessarily match the image. Can you figure out which is which before you log in?

The Faeria Team

notes.title: Faeria Friday, June 24th: 2016: The 257th Card
notes.content:
The next balance patch will be coming your way next week, and a new card along with it! It's also time for announcing the next Monthly Cup special guest.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/24Jun/banner.png

The 257th Card

With the last set of Monthly Cup qualifiers finishing this weekend, we will be patching the game early next week. As we've mentioned earlier, now that we have tournaments with cash prizes on a regular basis, we try to be as careful as possible with the dates of any patches that affect overall game balance in any way. That said, there will be times when the need to make adjustments for the health of the game trumps the need to maintain status quo for our competitive player's tournament preparations.

In this case, next week's patch will contain several balance adjustments, some new card art, and the introduction of Faeria's 257th card!

This card, like all others currently in the game, will be part of the current "core set." This means anyone who has already purchased the Full Collection at this time will be receiving this card automatically, for free. During Early Access, we plan on adding a few more to the core set before we consider it entirely complete.

Next Monthly Cup Guest

If it's Faeria Friday, that means it’s time to announce our second specially invited guest who will be competing in our First Monthly Cup:

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/lenard.png

AWLenard is Alienware’s global Community Manager, the man behind AlienwareTV, and an avid gamer. The Alienware Twitch channel features live streaming 6+ hours a day, 4 days a week, and from today until the day of our finals, Lenard will be featuring a “Road to the Cup” segment following his training to get ready for competition in just a few weeks. Go check their streams out, we’re sure he’ll be on the look-out for viewers to practice against or maybe even coach him.

Steam Summer Sale

In case you missed it, Faeria will be part of Steam's Summer Sale, from now until July 4th!
The Faeria Team

notes.title: Faeria Friday June 17th, 2016: Weekend Welcome
notes.content:
Welcome new players! We hope you enjoy your time with us this weekend. Let us know how we can make your stay more comfortable.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/17Jun/Banner.jpg

Weekend Welcome

Of course, the biggest news right now is that our Free Weekend is currently underway.

If you're new to Faeria and are looking for some helpful resources, try the following links:
Playfaeria.com - A great place to find some helpful articles, guides, videos, and a list of current Faeria streamers.Faeria Wiki - Our recently overhauled Wiki contains a lot of basic information you can use to help you get started in Faeria.Official Discord Channel - Chat live with other Faeria players! You'll find a lot of activity here.Official Forums - You'll need a Faeria account to use our forums - but if you're reading this, that's probably not an issue.Seifer and friends

We released a small client patch yesterday containing some new final art for a few cards. They're in game now, and look a little something like this:

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/17Jun/SeiferThumb.jpghttps://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/17Jun/SkyguardThumb.jpghttps://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/17Jun/WindThumb.jpghttps://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/17Jun/WarlordThumb.jpg
Seifer's Wrath > Concept by Jordi&Franck / Illustration by Tokkun StudioKhalim's Skyguard > Concept by Jordi&Franck / Illustration by VitaliyWind Soldier > Concept by Jordi&Franck / Illustration by Tokkun StudioKobold Warlord > Concept by Jordi&Franck / Illustration by Tokkun StudioFirst Monthly Cup Guest

It's time we announced our first specially invited guest who will be attending the First Monthly Cup:

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/P4WNY-1.png

If you haven't seen P4wnyhof stream Faeria before, you may recognize him as a caster on the TakeTV Twitch channel. Having competed previously in the GO Faeria Clash finals last April, this German player will be returning for another shot at a championship.

Make sure to wish him good luck on his Twitch channel!

Dreamhack Summer

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/FF/17Jun/Dreamhack.jpg

The pack yaks have been unburdened, watered, and hitched outside. We have arrived.

Click here for a reminder of what we'll be doing at Dreamhack.

Season One Top 8 Finals

The highest Gods from Season One of the Ranked ladder square off this Saturday at 4pm CEST!

Prizes
1st place: $1502nd place: $1003rd place: $50
Look for most of the matches to be streamed live on Crow's Twitch channel. Keep an eye on our Discord channel for more information if you'd like to tune in. Be sure to check out some videos from last weekend's qualifiers as well, recently uploaded to YouTube.

Who do you think will win?

I'm asking. I honestly don't know.

-Gary(@Atmaz)

notes.title: Patch notes: June 15th, 2016
notes.content:
This patch introduces "Seasonal" Elo to the Ranked ladder, periodic rating decay, as well as a few bug fixes for cards.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/banner-warlord_1092x496.jpg


New features
A "Seasonal Rating" system has been implemented for both Ranked play and Pandora.A "Rating Decay" system has been implemented for both Ranked play and Pandora.Dropping a run in Pandora will now reduce your "Seasonal Rating" for Pandora

Bug fixes
Ancient Herald and Spring Mochi will now properly bestow their gifts after being transformed.Fixed a bug involving multiple Magda's on board and her cost reduction to LegendariesFixed a bug where Windborne Emissary's attack increase was sometimes not being removed until the end of turnSome bugs involving the Linux version working properly have been fixed

What is Seasonal Rating?

A Seasonal Rating system is being added on top of the current rating system. The overall purpose of implementing Seasonal Rating is to allow the ladder positions of each season to remain fresh, while still matching players against one another according to their skill levels. Each player will now have two Elo ratings - their public "Seasonal Elo" which is the official ranking and will be displayed on our eSports website as normal, and a hidden "Matchmaking Elo" which the game server will use to match players against one another.

Seasonal Rating is different from Matchmaking Rating in three ways:
Seasonal Rating is affected by Rating DecaySeasonal Rating will be reset toward the baseline of 1500 at the end of each season, but not all the way. This is intended to maintain some previous progress for all players from season to season.Seasonal Rating is not used for calculations when matching players against one another
The first thing you should know about Seasonal Rating is that your current rating will remain the same after today's patch, and you will remain the same place you are currently in the ladder. After today, a new Rating Decay system will be in effect. While we cannot reveal the exact details of how the decay is calculated or applied to prevent abuse of the system, it works by slightly reducing your Seasonal Elo after a certain period of time of playing no games. You can avoid any rating decay at all by following the Golden Rule:

The Golden Rule of Rating Decay

In Ranked or Pandora, from the beginning of a season - play one game every three days and you will never experience any Rating Decay.

It's that simple!

Note that in today's update, everyone is starting fresh as far as rating decay is concerned. Decay will only begin to accumulate after today.

------------------------------------------------------  

Thanks, everybody. As a side note, we have moved the announcements for the special invitees in the Monthly Cup to Fridays, to correspond with each Faeria Friday. This means this week's announcement will be delayed by two days.

Have a good day!
The Faeria Team

notes.title: Patch notes: June 10th, 2016
notes.content:
A set of features that prepare us for this weekend's Monthly Cup Qualifiers, some important bug fixes, and new art.

http://i.imgur.com/7Mp4ZNM.png

Tournament feature update:
A button has been added in the deck sign-up screen to allow you to un-signup all decks.Tournaments lobby will now behave in "Pantheon" mode :When a deck loses, you CANNOT use it again in the same match.Players won't be able to have more than three copies of the same card in the 3 decksLegendaries are limited to one per three decks.A draw or a game crash will give one win to both players.Draws and crashes will not force to switch decks.Should a match result in a 2-2 because of a draw or a crash, the players will have to keep playing until one of them wins.After a draw or a crash, the Timebank will be restored to the state it was before the match.

Bug Fixes :
Firebringer is no longer buffed when a creature with increased life is played.Twinsoul Spirit can no longer be played on any land.Wavecrash Colossus correctly reduces its cost by 1 instead of 2.Fixed an issue where Pandora decks could appear in the constructed decks list.

New illustrations :
Explore Concept by Jordi / Illustration by VitaliyQueen's Assassin Concept by Jordi and Franck / Illustration by VitaliyPossessed Ursus by SarahDeepwood Grizzly by SarahKobold Warbeast Concept by Christophe / Illustration by Tokkun StudioFlame Spitter Concept by Jordi and Franck / Illustration by Tokkun Studio

notes.title: DreamHack Summer. a Free Weekend on Steam, and an AMA!
notes.content:
This June, we'll be setting up at DreamHack Summer and are planning a Free Weekend on Steam!

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/News_DH.jpg


DreamHack Summer

We are excited to announce that Faeria will have a presence at DreamHack Summer 2016 in Sweden!

What will we be doing?

We will have a joint booth along with Alienware and ROCCAT, where a set of laptops will be dedicated to playing Faeria. We will be holding a giveaway of an Alienware laptop for those who create an account and play through the tutorial, and then enter a special code that we will be giving out at the event. Entering the code will also give those players a promotional set of booster packs and Pandora coins. Krog be praised.

Who will be there?

Heroically manning the booth will be none other than community podcast organizer and tournament commentator, Scream112!

http://i.imgur.com/LNPvbgj.png

Since late 2013, Scream112 has been bringing us The Kappa Council, a Faeria centered podcast featuring various community members. You can also find him routinely streaming Faeria or covering Faeria tournaments on his Twitch.tv channel, MetagamingTV.

We’ve chosen him to represent us at DreamHack Summer in Sweden, but he’s not all who will be there. We’ll have a couple of known personalities stopping by the booth to say hello, including Lothar, host of the GO Faeria Clash finals.

If you’re attending DreamHack on the weekend of June 18th, make sure to stop by our booth and say hello!

Faeria Free Weekend

Around the same time as DreamHack, we will be hosting a Free Weekend on Steam!

Free Weekend dates:
June 16th - 19th
Anyone will be able to download and play Faeria during this time, for free. It’s the perfect time to give it a try. Help us spread the word!

Early Access Discount
During the Free Weekend and for a short time after, we will also have a discount applied to any Early Access purchases made via Steam.

Steam Discount dates
June 16th - 21st
Discount rates:
Early Access Bundle: 50% discount appliedEarly Access only: 30% discount applied

After the Free Weekend is over, players will need to buy one of the Early Access options in order to resume playing the game; however all progress made and cards earned will remain intact, regardless of their choice, until they either enter Early Access, or log into their account after we go Free-to-Play later this year.

AMA Thread

As mentioned last Friday, today we will be hosting an “Ask Me Anything” on our Official Forums. Make sure to stop by and ask us any questions you may have.

Go ahead and Ask Us Anything.

We’d love to hear from you!

The Faeria Team

notes.title: Pandora: Introducing Phantom Runs
notes.content:
Welcoming Phantom Runs - a new way to access Pandora - and other interesting updates!

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Pandora_Shore_News.png


Introducing Phantom and Premium Pandora runs

Welcome to a new era, an era full of rewards for the most passionate of you! We are continuously tweaking the Pandora experience and today we are very proud to announce the introduction of Phantom and Premium Runs.

With Faeria, we want you to feel at home. We want you to be able to choose which mode you like the most and play it as much as you want. But at the same time, you should have the opportunity to feel the thrill and gamble to win big!

This is why we are introducing two different type runs that are intended to fullfil the needs of our players:

Phantom Runs

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/phantom-coin.png

Phantom runs have been designed to allow you to experience Pandora once a day, for free. At your first login, each day, you will receive a free Phantom Coin that will grant you acccess to a Phantom Run (if you don't have a free coin from a previous day already).

Phantom runs can be finished through either 6 wins or 2 losses. If you wish to play extra Phantom runs, they cost 50 Gold.

The rewards are as follow:
0 Victories: 0 Gold1 Victory: 15 Gold2 Victories: 30 Gold 3 Victories: 50 Gold 4 Victories: 75 Gold5 Victories: 100 Gold6 Victories: 100 Gold + 1 Pandora Coin

Pandora Runs

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/pandora-coin.png

Pandora runs have been designed to maximise the thrill and the rewards. A Pandora run costs 250 Gold or $1.49 and can be finished through, either 12 wins or 3 losses.

By choosing to play a Pandora Run, you are guaranteed to win one Booster Pack, Gold and Memoria! But that's not it, for the most worthy out there (6 wins and more), you will have the chance to win Mythical Cards, such as the mighty Krog below.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Gold%20Krog.png

Ladder Season Reset

As announced last month (Ladder Seasons are coming), we have finished the first Ladder Season and it's been a blast! By now, if you were ranked 15 or below, you should have a gorgeous new Card Back. For the Gods among you, your version is golden!

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Faeria_Ladder_S1_CB.pnghttps://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Faeria_Ladder_S1_CB_God.png

Faeria Monthly Cup: Community votes are now open

As introduced with the Faeria Monthly Cups, one of the cool ways to get into the Finals is to get voted by the community. We are pleased to announce that those votes are now open!

Reminder: Answer the Survey and win 400 Gold!

As mentioned last week (Faeria Friday 06/03), we have a community survey running where you have a chance to win 400 Gold! Your feedback is very valuable for us :)

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Faeria_Community_Survey.png

Balancing

General:
Sagami Elder: Costs 1 less ForestCrumbling Golem: Now loses life when your opponent summons a creature (instead of when they play any card).Axe Grinder: Now a 4/3 that gets +1/+1. Lord of Terror: Now a 1/5Flame Burst: Now costs 3f and 2M and deals 3 damageEarthcraft (previously Breath of Life): Now costs 2f and 1F with the following ability "Draw a card and choose one: Create a desert, Create a lake, Create a mountain, Create a Desert"Malevolent Spirit: Now drains 2 life Outcast Tower (previously Outcast Cemetery): Now costs 0f with the following abilities "Empty all Faeria wells" and "Production - Deal 1 damage to this structure"
Pandora specifics:
Removal of Orosei's Mustache and Noodle Bowl from the Pandora ArtifactsAddition of the Pandora Artifact "Necklace of the Damned": Add a 1f Plague Bearer to each player's handEcho (Created by the Conch Horn artifact): Costs 1f moreCharge (Created by the Jeweled Boots artifact): Costs 1f moreGarudan's Scale: Now deals 2 damage instead of 3The Complete ChangelogIntroduction of the Phantom and Premium Pandora Runs (and their respectives rewards)You'll now receive a Phantom Coin each day, for free and foreverYou can now craft and disenchant Mythic CardsFixed the old avatar that was sometimes displayed in the lobbyFixed the "zZz" that appears when a creature is evolvedPrevious effects and triggers for cards that are drawn (example: Imperial Guards drawn by Hold the Line will have +2/+2 if Eredon's Drums artifact (gives +2/+2 to ALL creatures) was played)"Rank Up" won't be shown anymore when you lose New card art: Court Jester, Defender of the Homeland, Master Swordsman, Demon Wing and Cannon CarrierFixed draw that was keeping players stuck in the game in PandoraSeason Reset is now effective and you should have received your rewards based on your RankingInterface improvementsSagami Elder: Costs 1 less ForestCrumbling Golem: Now loses life when your opponent summons a creature (instead of when they play any card).Axe Grinder: Now a 4/3 that gets +1/+1. Lord of Terror: Now a 1/5Flame Burst: Now costs 3f and 2M and deals 3 damageEarthcraft (previously Breath of Life): Now costs 2f and 1F with the following ability "Draw a card and choose one: Create a desert, Create a lake, Create a mountain, Create a Desert"Malevolent Spirit: Now drains 2 life Outcast Tower (preivously Outcast Cemetery): Now costs 0f with the following abilities "Empty all Faeria well" and "Production - Deal 1 damage to this structure"Removal of Orosei's Mustache and Noodle Bowl from the Pandora ArtifactsAddition of the Pandora Artifact Necklace of the Damned: Add a 1f Plague Bearer to each player's handEcho (Created by the Conch Horn artifact): Costs 1f moreCharge (Created by the Jeweled Boots artifact): Costs 1f moreGarudan's Scale: Now deals 2 damage instead of 3

It's time to jump into Faeria and test it out!

Phantom runs have been designed to allow you to experience Pandora once a day, for free. At your first login, each day, you will receive a free Phantom Coin that will grant you acccess to a Phantom Run (if you don't have a free coin from a previous day already).

Phantom runs can be finished through either 6 wins or 2 losses. If you wish to play extra Phantom runs, they cost 50 Gold.

The rewards are as follow:
0 Victories: 0 Gold1 Victory: 15 Gold2 Victories: 30 Gold 3 Victories: 50 Gold 4 Victories: 75 Gold5 Victories: 100 Gold6 Victories: 100 Gold + 1 Pandora Coin

Pandora Runs

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/pandora-coin.png

Pandora runs have been designed to maximise the thrill and the rewards. A Pandora run costs 250 Gold or $1.49 and can be finished through, either 12 wins or 3 losses.

By choosing to play a Pandora Run, you are guaranteed to win one Booster Pack, Gold and Memoria! But that's not it, for the most worthy out there (6 wins and more), you will have the chance to win Mythical Cards, such as the mighty Krog below.

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Gold%20Krog.png

https://faeriapublic.s3.amazonaws.com/website/news/Faeria_Community_Survey.png
